purpose: Lays out children in one direction with a consistent gap from the spacing scale.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px (default), lg 24px, section 32px between page sections

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets a horizontal stack wrap onto new lines

whenToUse: Any group of elements that sit one after another: form fields, button rows, sections of a page
sm inside a group, md between fields, section between page sections
whenNotToUse: For equal columns of cards or tiles — use Grid
To indent or pad content — padding belongs to Card, Section or the template
antiPatterns: Inline margins or padding to space elements instead of a Stack gap
Mixing gap sizes between siblings at the same level
a11yNotes: Purely visual: adds no role; reading and tab order follow source order, which Stack never changes
